annotator: Claude (AI assistant), reading each image after the reader was frozen (commit b12ce13) and before running it on these figures; to be spot-checked by the project team before the thesis cites results

definitions.screened: number assessed for eligibility or screened (top of the flow); null if the diagram gives no number
definitions.enrolled: number stated as enrolled, included, recruited, or as having met or fulfilled the inclusion criteria, when shown as its own stage; 'qualified' or 'eligible' alone count as screening, not enrolment
definitions.randomised: number randomised; if no randomised box, the sum of the allocated arms
definitions.analysed: total analysed in the first-listed (usually intention-to-treat) analysis, summed across arms
definitions.is_participant_flow: false when the figure is some other kind of flowchart with no participant counts
definitions.unscored: stages the diagram leaves genuinely ambiguous; excluded from scoring rather than guessed
